gap_plan._note: Realistic ways to close a gap, shown beside the tailored resume (never printed).
gap_plan.airflow: Run Job Radar's daily job as an Airflow DAG in Docker on your laptop. About 2 weekends; then you can say you've scheduled a real pipeline with Airflow.
gap_plan.dbt: Do the free dbt Fundamentals course, then model Job Radar's SQLite tables with dbt-duckdb. About 1–2 weeks of evenings.
gap_plan.docker: Package Job Radar in a Dockerfile and run it locally. One weekend, and it pairs well with Airflow.
gap_plan.spark: Databricks free edition with a PySpark notebook on a public dataset (e.g. data.gov.my). About 2 weeks; say 'learning', not 'expert'.
gap_plan.databricks: Databricks free edition plus the free Databricks Academy fundamentals badge. About 1–2 weeks.
gap_plan.snowflake: Snowflake 30-day free trial: load Job Radar's jobs table and write the same queries. One weekend.
gap_plan.aws: AWS free tier: put the daily SQLite or CSV output in S3 and query it with Athena. 1–2 weekends.
gap_plan.azure: Microsoft Learn's free Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) path; the exam is often free in Microsoft events. About 3 weeks.
gap_plan.gcp: Google Cloud free tier: load a CSV into BigQuery and schedule a query. One weekend.
gap_plan.tableau: Tableau Public (free): rebuild your breakdown dashboard on synthetic data and link it. One weekend.
gap_plan.ci/cd: You already run GitHub Actions in Job Radar. Add a test step to a second repo and mention it. A few evenings.
gap_plan.data modeling: Draw the star schema behind your breakdown report (facts: callbacks, PM; dimensions: lift, site, date). Real work you already did; just document it. One evening.
gap_plan.data warehouse: Same as data modelling, plus a small dbt or DuckDB warehouse of public data. 1–2 weeks.
gap_plan.stakeholder management: Already true: you train maintenance staff, handle user requests and escalate to vendors. Use those as interview examples rather than learning anything new.
gap_plan.data quality: Already true: your invoice reconciliation and ticket matching are data-quality checks. Say so in the interview.
gap_plan.process mapping: Draw the Callback work-order flow (Create > Approve > Process > Realize) as a diagram. One evening; real work.
gap_plan.uat: Already close: you test Synergy changes before users get them. Describe one change you tested.
gap_plan.agile: Read the Scrum Guide (free, 20 min) and frame your pipeline work as small weekly releases.
gap_plan.jira: Free Jira account: track Job Radar's backlog for a month. Small effort; mention only if asked.
gap_plan.kafka: Confluent's free Kafka 101 course. Mention as 'learning' only.
gap_plan.linux: Use WSL on your laptop to run Job Radar from a Linux shell. A few evenings.
gap_plan.machine learning: Your coursework (regression, PCA, SVR) counts; keep it modest.
gap_plan.r: Course-level R from UMT counts; list it only if the ad asks.
gap_plan.salesforce: Free Trailhead badges (Admin Beginner). Only if you want CRM roles.
gap_plan.sap: openSAP free courses. Only if you want ERP roles; your Exact experience transfers.
